simple.meaning: צֶפַע (tsephaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a viper (as thrusting out the tongue, i.e. hissing ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across Proverbs, Isaiah, Jeremiah, beginning at Proverbs 23:32. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צֶפַע (H6848).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
